content.text:
`partyChart` is the narrow owner for a chart-only Labour grouping.

- Its sole caller is [FunderSummary.svelte](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/FunderSummary.svelte:12), which supplies GBP party totals. Slices drive the pie, legend, entry counts, unavailable counts, and tooltips together.
- [funder-summary.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/funder-summary.ts:12) currently preserves every party row and derives shares using exact scaled `BigInt` arithmetic. Null and negative amounts contribute zero to pie shares.
- [entity-details.ts](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/frontend/src/lib/entity-details.ts:77) gives each party `{partyName, amount, entryCount, unknownAmountCount}`. Amount is a decimal string or null. The API sends `party_id`, but this frontend model drops it.
- Backend grouping uses `(party_id, party_name)` in [entity_details.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_details.rs:191). Changing that would change API semantics and all consumers.

Recommended ownership: group the relevant Labour names into a fresh chart input inside `partyChart`, before calculating shares. Sum known signed amounts exactly, sum both counts, and retain null when all merged amounts are unavailable. Apply the existing positive-total rule after aggregation. This makes legend and tooltip values match the merged slice without changing member records or API output.

Edge cases: Labour alone; Co-op alone; both; mixed decimal scales; null plus known amount; all-null amounts; negative totals; unrelated parties; input immutability. Preserve stable ordering or explicitly sort grouped totals if slices should remain ranked.

Repository evidence confirms only the party name `Labour`: [add_members.sql](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/db/fixtures/add_members.sql:14) and [integration.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/tests/integration.rs:119). No Labour Co-op party spelling appears in tracked source or fixtures, so aliases cannot be established from this checkout alone.
